resources.string: Your key is stored locally on this device only and never shared.
How to create your API key:

1. Go to console.cloud.google.com
2. Create or select a project
3. Link a billing account to the project
4. Enable: Routes API, Places API, Geocoding API
5. Go to Credentials → Create Credentials → API Key
6. Copy the key and paste it below

Notifications are blocked, so ETA Alert cannot tell you when to leave. Enable notifications for ETA Alert in Settings, then try again.

ETA Alert collects your device location, including while the app is closed or not in use, so it can keep checking live traffic between where you are and your destination.

Your location is sent directly from this device to Google Maps to calculate your drive time. It is never sent to us, never stored on a server, and never shared with anyone else.

Location is only used while you are tracking a trip. Tracking stops automatically when you are alerted or when your tracking window ends.
ETA Alert needs your location to check traffic. You can start tracking once you allow it.
